dc_backup_invalid.why: The data-centre backup routes (PUT /api/campus-electrical/{name}/dc-backup, POST .../dc-backup/assess) refused a backup setting (mode genset, bess or hybrid, or a BESS assumption) that fails the create body's checks, or a project that is not a data centre. Nothing was stored; the network and the investment case are untouched. The message and `field` name what to fix, shown next to that field in the Backup section.
